reuse.why: Extracts the four copies of the month-wide category query and income rule into getMonthWideCategories and has the new action and all existing month-wide actions use it, reusing NO_TEMPLATE_SQL, getSheetValue, setBudget and batchMessages.

duplication.why: Removes the four duplicated SELECT blocks and per-loop income checks, and folds set6/set12 into one setAllNMonthAvg; the new action adds no copied logic.

placement.why: The selection helper and new action live in budget/actions.ts with the other month-wide actions, and the method is registered in budget/app.ts with mutator(undoable(...)) like its siblings.

scope.why: Centralising the category selection serves the 'same categories' requirement; collapsing set6/set12 into setAllNMonthAvg is a small extra refactor beyond the request.

maintainability.why: Which categories a month-wide action fills is now defined once, so a maintainer changes the rule in one place for every action including the new one.
